item.name: Necklace of Bitter Tears
entries: Whenever you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|X{HB} while wearing this necklace, your weapon attacks before the end of your next turn deal an additional {@dice 1d4} poison damage.

item.name: Bracers of Extreme Evocation
entries: Whenever you cast a spell, you can take a penalty to the spell's casting (described below) in order to roll an additional {@dice 2d6} damage when determining the spell's damage. If a spell requires multiple attack rolls or repeats a saving throw, this applies to all of them.

items: If the spell requires an attack roll, take a -5 penalty to that roll.
If it requires a saving throw, targets have advantage on that saving throw.

item.name: Gloves of Benign Transposition
entries: When you hit or affect a willing creature with an attack or spell, you may swap places with them.

item.name: Gloves of Malicious Transposition
entries: These gloves have 3 charges, which are restored when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you hit or affect a creature with an attack or spell, you may expend a charge to swap places with them. An unwilling creature may make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw to avoid the effect.

item.name: Ring of Mana Channeling
entries: While {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating}, your weapon attacks deal 2 additional damage of the weapon's type.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The additional damage is Force, and equal to your spellcasting ability modifier instead of 2.

item.name: Ring of Protection
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|Saving Throws} while wearing this ring.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: and +1 to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|Armour Class}.

item.name: Cloak of Protection
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|Saving Throws} while wearing this cloak.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: and +1 to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|Armour Class}.

item.name: A Promise Made
entries: This ring shares a single charge with {@item A Promise Kept|Starlight}, which recovers when you complete a long rest.
The wearer can expend the charge to cast {@spell Unshakeable Tail|J:Portalist}, {@spell Warding Bond|phb}, or {@spell Sanctuary|phb} on the bearer of A Promise Kept.

item.name: A Promise Kept
entries: This ring shares a single charge with {@item A Promise Made|Starlight}, which recovers each when you complete a long rest.
The wearer can expend the charge to cast {@spell Unshakeable Tail|J:Portalist}, {@spell Warding Bond|XPHB}, or {@spell Sanctuary|XPHB} on the bearer of A Promise Made.

item.name: Circlet of Storytelling
entries: Stories you tell gain a subtle effect to make them more compelling.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) checks, and can conjure small images of the tales you tell in the form of blurred cloudy images above your head.

item.name: Soulful Rook Chesspiece
entries: This appears to be a normal chesspiece, except that the floor of the rook's battlements glows slightly.
You may teleport up to 90 feet in any cardinal direction. You may not teleport past any creature in those directions.

Additionally, the next attack you make this turn after teleporting, on a hit, forces the target to make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are moved 10 feet in a direction of your choice.
You may use this ability only if you haven't moved this turn, and you are {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of your turn when you use it.
Once the piece has been used this way, you cannot use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, during which time the piece stops glowing.

item.name: Soulful Queen Chesspiece
entries: This appears to be a normal chesspiece, except that the queen's crown glows slightly.
You may teleport up to 90 feet in any ordinal or cardinal direction. You may not teleport past any creature in those directions.

Additionally, the next attack you make this turn after teleporting, on a hit, forces the target to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they are {@condition Frightened|phb} of you until the start of your next turn.
You may use this ability only if you haven't moved this turn, and you are {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of your turn when you use it.
Once the piece has been used this way, you cannot use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, during which time the piece stops glowing.

item.name: Soulful Bishop Chesspiece
entries: This appears to be a normal chesspiece, except that the bishop's mitre glows slightly.
You may teleport up to 90 feet in any ordinal direction. You may not teleport past any creature in those directions.

Additionally, you roll an additional {@dice 1d6} when determinig the damage of the next attack you make this turn after teleporting. This attack can restore hit points, instead of dealing damage, if you choose.
You may use this ability only if you haven't moved this turn, and you are {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of your turn when you use it.
Once the piece has been used this way, you cannot use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, during which time the piece stops glowing.

item.name: Soulful Knight Chesspiece
entries: This appears to be a normal chesspiece, except that the floor of the rook's battlements glows slightly.
You may teleport up to 60 feet in any direction except the cardinal or ordinal ones.
Additionally, the next attack you make this turn after teleporting, on a hit, {@condition Hampered|Starlight|Hampers} your target's movement until the start of your next turn.
You may use this ability only if you haven't moved this turn, and you are {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of your turn when you use it.
Once the piece has been used this way, you cannot use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, during which time the piece stops glowing.

item.name: Quickstep Boots
entries: When you take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action while wearing these boots, you can immediately move 5 feet without provoking {@variantrule Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

item.name: Eye of the 10-eyed Wyrm
entries: One of the eyes of the mighty Dreaad Serpent Anach-Tal'lul. merely possessing it grants the bearer one of His many powers. Such powers can be difficult to handle, however, and this imposes limitations on mortals using them.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The eye has two charges, which recover when you complete a long rest. As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend one charge to grant yourself one benefit from the table, and its associated detriment, for one hour.

rows: You gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on initiative checks.
On your first turn in combat, you are {@condition Slowed|Starlight}.
You gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ability checks.
You gain {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ability checks.
You gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attacks.
You gain {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all saving throws.
You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
You gain {@variantrule Vulnerablity|XPHB} to Fire, Cold, and Lightning damage.

item.name: Blessed Circlet
entries: You receive {@dice 1d4} (additional) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} when you are healed with a spell, or when you heal others with a spell.

item.name: Career Student's Ring
entries: While wearing this ring, you can add half of your proficiency bonus to any any skill in which you are not already proficient.
{@note This does not combine with the Bard's 'Jack of All Trades' feature, or other similar features.}

item.name: Forgotten Green Hood
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB} or {@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) checks.
You cannot be targeted by Divination magic or perceived through magical means, such as a {@spell Scrying|XPHB} sensor or looking through a {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB|familiar's} eyes.

item.name: Friend of Arcanists
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) and Intelligence ({@skill History|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Druids
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Nature|XPHB}) and Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Priests
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Religion|XPHB}) and Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Warriors
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Parties
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) and Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Thieves
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Urchins
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of the Paranoid
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) and Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Light-foots
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Stealth)|XPHB} and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Hunter's Shawl
entries: While wearing this cloak, if you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to its CR or level.

item.name: Hunter's Hood
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks made to spot creatures who are {@action Hide|XPHB|Hiding} from you.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can cast the {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} spell at 3rd level. A creature marked in this way takes the additional damage from {@b all} weapon attacks, not just yours. Once you do so, the spell cannot be cast this way until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Hunter's Boots
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws made to escape being {@condition Grappled|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB}.

item.name: Hunter's Bracers
entries: Hostile creatures within 5 feet of you do not impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your ranged attacks.

item.name: Hunter's Ring
entries: You gain a {@dice 1d4} bonus to attack rolls made against creatures who are under the effects of {@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB}, {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}, or the {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} feature.

item.name: Moon-Touched Bracelet
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant damage while you are wearing this ring.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can store one spell of up to 3rd level within the bracelet. Any creature can cast a spell of 1st through 3rd level into the bracelet by touching the bracelet as the spell is cast. The spell's effect is then stored for later use.

While wearing the bracelet, you can cast the spell stored in it; the spell uses the same level as when it was cast, as well as the spell save DC, attack bonus and spellcasting ablity of the original caster, but is otherwise treated as if you had cast it. Once cast, the spell is removed from the bracelet.

item.name: Ring of Borrowed Time
entries: If you start your turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and are not {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}, you remain conscious and can act as normal, borrowing time from your own potential future.

You automatically fail one {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB} at the end of your turn instead of rolling one at the start of your turn. Damage taken still causes a failed {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB} as normal.

This state ends when you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, become {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}, or die. Once this state ends, the ring loses its magic until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Cloak of the Timekeeper
entries: Attacks that deal Force damage are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} against you, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} against an effect that would cause you to take Force damage on a success or failure.

item.name: Stopped-clock Circlet
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you can halt an effect or spell that targets an area that you can see. Before the end of your next turn, you can release the effect (no action required) at its original target space.
Once used, this cannot be used again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can choose to {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrate} on the effect (as if you were {@status concentration|XPHB|concentrating} on a spell) in order to choose a new target point from the effect when you release it (as if it originated from you). It still uses the original statistics.

item.name: Time-knife Gloves
entries: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack roll while wearing these gloves, it loses a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, if it has any.

item.name: Boots of Excellent Positioning
entries: These boots have 5 charges which are recovered upon completing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Whenever you are moved against your will, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and one charge to teleport to any space you occupied after the start of your previous turn.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can use the {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend a charge at any time, instead of only when you are moved against your will.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: While in combat, you regain {@dice 1d4} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of your turns.

item.name: Amulet of Unmitigated Gall
entries: Anyone wearing this amulet cannot have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Charisma ability checks.
The wearer has a +1 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) and Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) checks.

item.name: Cloak of the Profane Elf
entries: {@b Hellish Rebuke.} Creatures that hit you with a melee attack become {@condition Burning|Starlight} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Cloak of Arcane Bolstering
entries: You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your spellcasting modifier when you cast a spell while within 5 feet of a hostile creature.

item.name: Cloak of the Wind
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is increased by 5 feet.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is increased by 10 feet instead.

item.name: Apathetic Cloak
entries: This cloak foils spells cast to determine your thoughts and intentions (such as {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB} or {@spell Zone of Truth|XPHB}), and grants you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence saving throws.

item.name: Sanctuary Rose Cutting
entries: This pale blue rose petal glows dimly within its jar, emitting 5 feet of {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} at all times and is surrounded by floating motes of light, which occasionally hit the glass.

While holding the jar, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn or as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you take damage that doesn't reduce you to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can shatter the jar and release its magic to protect yourself. This reduces your current hit points to 1, and until the end of your next turn you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all damage and to all effects that would move you against your will.

item.name: Sanctuary Rose
entries: This pale blue rose glows dimly, emitting 10 feet of dim light at all times and is surrounded by floating motes of light.

While holding the rose, on your turn (no action required) or as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you take damage that doesn't reduce you to 0 hit points, you can channel its magic to protect yourself. This reduces your current hit points to 1, and until the end of your next turn you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all damage and to all effects that would move you against your will.
Once this effect is used, the Rose must spend an hour in direct moonlight (under any moon phase except for new) before it can be used again.

item.name: Darkmoon Dhalia
entries: This dark purple flower emits a faint mist of dim light when held, suppressing any other light sources within a 30 foot radius and replacing that light with {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}.
Any creatures who take Necrotic damage while in this dim light take an additional {@dice 1d6} Necrotic damage.

item.name: Chalice of Light
entries: Once each day, this chalice can be used to pour out a vial's worth of {@item Holy Water (flask)|XPHB|holy water}. This holy water becomes mundane water when the Chalice is used again.
As an action, the holy water can be drank to end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition or one disease afflicting the character.

Over the course of one minute, this vial can also be used to coat a weapon, granting it a +1 bonus to attack rolls and +1 Radiant damage. The coating lasts for one hour and for the duration the weapon is considered magical for the purposes of overcoming resistances.

item.name: Coin of Future Problems
entries: Once per day, you can hold onto this coin and hope for a little extra luck (no action required). You gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on a {@variantrule D20 Test} when you do so (you can do this during or after the roll). The next D20 Test you make after that has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

item.name: Shepherd Stones
entries: These three stones float around you at all times and attempt to protect you from harm. While attuned, when an attack is made that targets you, a sphere will intercept it and negate it. Once a sphere has intercepted an attack, it becomes inert and drops to the ground. Inert spheres recover once the user has completed a {@variantrule Long Rest}.
The spheres can be deactivated or reactivated as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action. While deactivated, they do not intercept attacks.

item.name: Astral Teardrop
entries: You can fail an additional death saving throw before dying (4 total).

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You are immune to possession or mind control effects (such as {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} or {@spell Dominate Person|XPHB}).

item.name: Genie Vessel
entries: {@note This item could take several forms, such as an oil lamp, an urn, a ring with a compartment, or similar small container.}

While this tiny object is on your person, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} to vanish and enter the vessel, which remains in the space you left. The interior of the vessel is an extradimensional space in the shape of a 20-foot-radius cylinder, 20 feet high, and resembles your vessel. The interior is appointed with cushions and low tables and is a comfortable temperature. While inside, you can hear the area around your vessel as if you were in its space.

You can remain inside the vessel for a maximum of 10 hours. You exit the vessel early if you use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to leave, if you die, or if the vessel is reduced to zero hit points. When you exit the vessel, you appear in the unoccupied space closest to it. Any objects left in the vessel remain there until carried out, and if the vessel is destroyed, every object stored there harmlessly appears in the unoccupied spaces closest to the vessel's former space.

The vessel has 18 AC, 45 hit points, and is immune to poison and psychic damage. When reduced to zero hit points, it becomes immune to all damage for one minute. If you do not pick it up and use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to repair it in this timeframe, it is destroyed. Once repaired, it regains all of its hit points.
